spindle.observe.DeliveryGuarantee.title: DeliveryGuarantee
spindle.observe.DeliveryGuarantee.description: How many times an event binding's command may run for one event, as the binding's `delivery:` writes it. The words are ESS's (`Delivery` in ESS 0.90.0 `crates/specify/ess-domain/src/binding.rs`, carried on `ResolvedBinding::delivery`), and Spindle publishes them unchanged. `at_least_once`: the command may run again, so it must be idempotent; Spindle redelivers an envelope to another component whose acknowledgement is overdue. `at_most_once`: one send and no redelivery. Neither is exactly once. In either, Spindle sends nothing for an event before the state that published it is durable (`crates/spindle-channel/src/lib.rs`).
